name: AL PoC: Intake PG order (Pub/Sub to SAP or Draft Order)

nodes.name: ReceivePubSubNotification
nodes.notes: Google Pub/Sub push subscription stand-in. Acknowledged immediately; the email is pulled afterwards (notify-then-pull).

nodes.name: PullEmailFromMailbox

parameters.query: select email_id, from_addr, subject, body_text, received_at, attachments from al_poc.mailbox where email_id = $1;

nodes.notes: Gmail stand-in. Customer instance: Gmail API users.messages.get plus attachments.get with the service account.

parameters.query:
insert into al_poc.order_intake (order_id, email_id, execution_id, status)
values ($1, $2, $3, 'received')
on conflict (order_id) do update set execution_id = excluded.execution_id, status = 'received', started_at = now(),
  finished_at = null, decision = null, sap_order_number = null, draft_order_id = null
returning order_id, email_id;

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are the order-intake extraction step for Air Liquide packaged gases. Read the customer email and the attachment text (French, German or English) and return JSON matching the schema. Copy product wording and codes exactly as written; never translate a product code. Quantities are plain numbers. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd') }}. If something is absent use an empty string, 0 or an empty array; never invent. Empty cylinders the customer sends back go in empty_bottle_returns, not in lines. Set confidence low when the text is ambiguous or the attachment is unreadable.

nodes.name: ExtractorModel
nodes.notes: Lab model. Customer instance: Gemini on Air Liquide's own API key or Vertex AI, by replacing this sub-node.

nodes.name: MarkNotAnOrder
nodes.notes: Inquiries, complaints and pure returns stop here. Production: hand to the order desk queue as a non-order case.

workflowId.__workflowName: AL PoC: Product Agent (resolve lines against catalog)
AL PoC: Shipping Agent (resolve Ship-To and cut-off)

parameters.query:
update al_poc.order_intake set product_validation = $2::jsonb, shipping_validation = $3::jsonb, rules = $4::jsonb,
  critical_match = $5, decision = $6, status = 'validated'
where order_id = $1
returning order_id, decision;

nodes.name: WriteDraftExplanation
nodes.notes: Generative explainability: the AI writes the note on the Draft Order. The fixed reason wording comes from the gate, not the model.

nodes.name: ExplanationModel
nodes.notes: Lab model. Customer instance: Gemini on Air Liquide's own API key or Vertex AI, by replacing this sub-node.

nodes.name: CreateDraftOrder
nodes.notes: Salesforce stand-in for the pre-filled Draft Order in the manual queue.

parameters.query: update al_poc.order_intake set draft_order_id = $2, status = 'pending_review' where order_id = $1 returning order_id, draft_order_id;

parameters.subject: =[Draft Order] {{ $('ApplyBusinessRules').first().json.order.sold_to_name || $('AssembleDocument').first().json.from }}: {{ $('ApplyBusinessRules').first().json.reasons[0] }}

nodes.name: WaitForOrderDesk
nodes.notes: The execution sleeps here for hours or days at no worker cost. Production: resumed by the Salesforce Draft Order status change.

parameters.query:
with d as (update al_poc.draft_orders set status = 'rejected', resolved_at = now() where order_id = $1)
update al_poc.order_intake set status = 'rejected', finished_at = now() where order_id = $1 returning order_id, status;

nodes.name: PostSalesOrderToEsb
nodes.notes: TIBCO ESB stand-in. Customer instance: the ESB sales-order endpoint with the SAP service account. No node-level retry on purpose: the loop below is the exponential backoff.

parameters.query:
with d as (update al_poc.draft_orders set status = 'approved', resolved_at = now() where order_id = $1 and status = 'open')
update al_poc.order_intake set sap_order_number = $2, status = 'posted', finished_at = now()
where order_id = $1
returning order_id, sap_order_number, status, extract(epoch from (finished_at - started_at))::int as seconds;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.order_id, $execution.id, 'posted', 'ESB', 'SAP sales order ' + $json.sap_order_number + ' created in ' + $json.seconds + ' s', JSON.stringify({ sap_order_number: $json.sap_order_number, seconds: $json.seconds, attempts: 1 + ($('ComputeBackoff').isExecuted ? $('ComputeBackoff').all().length : 0) })] }}

={{ [$json.order_id, $execution.id, 'esb_retry', 'ESB', 'ESB call failed (HTTP ' + $json.http_status + '), attempt ' + $json.attempt + ' of ' + $json.max_attempts + ($json.retry ? ', retry in ' + $json.delay_seconds + ' s' : ', escalating'), JSON.stringify({ attempt: $json.attempt, delay_seconds: $json.delay_seconds, http_status: $json.http_status, error: $json.error_message })] }}

={{ (v => [v.order_id, v.order.sold_to_code, v.order.ship_to_code, JSON.stringify(v.order.lines), String($('ComputeBackoff').last().json.max_attempts), 'The order was validated but the ESB did not accept it after exponential backoff retries. Last error: ' + $('ComputeBackoff').last().json.error_message])($('ApplyBusinessRules').first().json) }}

parameters.query: update al_poc.order_intake set status = 'failed', draft_order_id = $2, finished_at = now() where order_id = $1 returning order_id, status;

parameters.subject: =[PG Order Intake] failure in execution {{ $execution.id }}
